title: Error Taxonomy
nlang_code:
mod blocks Errors {
  enum AphErrorCode {
    InvalidEnvelopeSignature,     // APH_E001
    InvalidFlowTransition,        // APH_E002
    MandateExpired,               // APH_E003
    RoleViolation,                // APH_E004
    ChannelNotAllowed,            // APH_E005
    NotarySignatureInvalid,       // APH_E006
    HumanAuthenticationRequired,  // APH_E007
    NotaryServiceUnreachable,     // APH_E008
    EnvelopeBodyHashMismatch,     // APH_E009
    UnsupportedAlgorithm,         // APH_E010
  }
}
note: Exactly ten codes in declaration order. The set is closed and the numbering is part of the contract: other implementations branch on these strings, so a duplicate or renumbering would make two distinct failures indistinguishable to a remote verifier. APH_E001 is an envelope proof failure; APH_E006 is a mandate signature failure — the distinction tells an operator which document to look at.
